fact_definition: Reported assertion from filing/company IR unless otherwise labeled; estimates and opinions separated.

facts.claim: FY2026 revenue $331.839B, operating income $155.237B, net income $133.749B, OCF $182.935B, cash PPE additions $115.948B and SBC $12.405B.
Q4 FY2026 Azure and other cloud services revenue grew 43% year over year.
FY2026 Microsoft Cloud revenue was $214.4B; Q4 Cloud gross margin was 65%.
Microsoft 365 Copilot had more than 30M paid seats; GitHub Copilot had 50M users at Q4 call.
Commercial RPO reached $678B; ex-OpenAI RPO grew 25%; all sequential commercial RPO growth in Q4 came from customers outside frontier-model companies.
Nearly 90% of FY2026 Microsoft Cloud revenue came from customers outside frontier-model companies.
Updated calendar-2026 capex expectation was approximately $175B after a shift of future datacenter leases toward operating-lease classification.

calculations.warning: Conservative diagnostic only; still not lease-aware normalized owner FCF.

calculations.formula: Retained Base economics, 9% hurdle, solve years 2-10 uniform growth

counter_evidence: Microsoft Cloud gross margin declined as Azure mix and AI infrastructure/usage increased.
FY2026 cash PPE almost doubled from FY2025, making reported earnings an incomplete measure of current reinvestment economics.
OpenAI commitments materially affect headline bookings/RPO and OpenAI investment accounting can create non-operating earnings volatility.
Competitive substitutes remain credible across hyperscale cloud, developer tools and frontier/open models.
